decisions.completedSave: After #223 no client writes a completed save: the migration client clears it on the first completed state and writes none after it, legacy saves only in 'diving', 'surface' and 'drill', and the codec reads every legacy save as not completed. The codec still accepts one from v12 on. The resume guard stays and the content specs resume such a save to reach the screen with a known dive, as the game-over spec resumes failed saves no client writes either; the test "a completed save is debriefed as it ended" was replaced by the two live surfacing tests, since its reason (the route moving a surfaced save back under 11 m) no longer holds.
decisions.preV13Saves: A dive resumed from a save older than the grade's inputs (v1-v12) is graded on defaults for the history it never held (the open note on #159 from Codex's review of #215). The screen does not mark those categories: no shipped writer produces such a save, since the migration client is unreachable until #170, and recording the missing history would need a save-version bump for a case no user can reach.
decisions.violationList: Legacy has no text list of the dive log's entries, only chart markers; the screen lists them with their dive time so they are reachable without the chart, and the chart (PR 3) numbers its markers to match.
decisions.safetyStopOutcome: Shown as legacy shows it: a warning with the explanation only when the stop was needed and not done; the grade's safety-stop row says when it was done or not needed.
